claim: MDN documents getUserMedia() as available only in secure contexts.
quote: This feature is available only in secure contexts (HTTPS), in some or all supporting browsers

claim: In an insecure context navigator.mediaDevices is undefined.
quote: This can also happen if you try to call getUserMedia() in an insecure context, since navigator.mediaDevices is undefined in an insecure context.

claim: When the user denies permission the promise rejects with NotAllowedError.
quote: If the user denies permission, or matching media is not available, then the promise is rejected with NotAllowedError or NotFoundError DOMException respectively.

claim: A page loaded from localhost is a secure context.
quote: A secure context is, in short, a page loaded using HTTPS or the file:/// URL scheme, or a page loaded from localhost
